findings.description: Missed PFL-POON_NAME-03. PDF explicitly states 'Unverified Discrepancy: Middle initial V. in ECA report unreferenced in proof of name' with three-way name variance (Rostova/Rostoff/V. Rostova), yet Worker reported only the generic requirement and flagged no defect. Its scanned sibling c3d9f81b caught this same defect — detection is non-deterministic across variants.

Missed PFL-POON_NAME-04. PDF shows Spanish 'Certificado de Cambio de Nombre' with 'Translation Certified: False', 'Translator Affidavit: N/A', and an informal self-translation, but Worker flagged no defect. Its scanned sibling 4dbe04eb correctly detected the identical uncertified-translation defect.

Missed PFL-POON_NAME-01. PDF shows 'Proof Of Other Name: N/A', 'Document Status: Missing Certificate', and narrative admitting the applicant 'failed to attach the mandatory government-issued certificate', yet Worker flagged no defect. Its vector sibling b6204160 correctly detected the missing certificate.

Grounding contradiction: basis asserts the applicant 'submitted supporting documentation under slot proof_of_other_name', but the PDF fields state Proof Of Other Name is N/A and Document Status is 'Missing Certificate'. The claim of submitted documentation is not supported by the source.

Correctly detected PFL-POON_NAME-04 with accurate field-grounded basis (translation_certified: false, translator_affidavit: null). Positive control confirming taxonomy is available to the Worker; the sibling miss (b3510812) is a consistency failure, not a knowledge gap.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Add a mandatory pre-verdict checklist that must be evaluated on EVERY case regardless of PDF variant (scanned vs vector): (1) PFL-POON_NAME-01 — if 'Proof Of Other Name' is N/A/blank or 'Document Status' contains 'Missing', flag missing certificate and NEVER assert documentation was submitted; (2) PFL-POON_NAME-02 — if 'Seal Present'/'Court Clerk Signature Present' is False or seal is N/A, flag unsealed court order; (3) PFL-POON_NAME-03 — compare passport_full_name, eca_applicant_name, degree_certificate_name and any 'Unverified Discrepancy' field; flag unresolved variance; (4) PFL-POON_NAME-04 — if Primary Language is non-EN/FR and Translation Certified is False or Translator Affidavit is N/A, flag uncertified translation. Verdict must be 'defective' whenever any check trips.

Require the Worker to derive its verdict strictly from explicit field values and narrative text before emitting the generic requirement claim. When a field literally reads 'False', 'N/A', or 'Missing Certificate', treat it as evidence of a defect, not as satisfied. Prohibit boilerplate basis statements like 'the applicant submitted documentation' unless a concrete document/certificate field is present and non-null.

Add determinism guardrail: identical logical cases rendered as scanned vs vector PDFs must yield identical defect findings. Instruct Workers to extract the labeled key/value table first, then run the failure-mode checklist against extracted values, so OCR/rendering differences cannot cause a defect to be caught on one variant and missed on its sibling.

rationale: Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) produced clean, PII-safe reports: all applicant facts stayed in basis[], claims/prose held only generic guideline text, and consistent citation to the completeness-check corpus (#064). Blind compliance is strong — the pattern of inconsistent detection confirms no ground-truth leakage. The dominant weakness is defect recall: 3 of 8 defective cases were missed (378ead7a POON-03, b3510812 POON-04, b3fb24ac POON-01), while their siblings were caught, indicating non-deterministic evaluation across scanned/vector variants rather than a knowledge gap. b3fb24ac additionally fabricated a 'submitted documentation' basis contradicting the 'Missing Certificate' PDF fields (grounding docked to 0.4). Both meets_requirements cases (828adaf9, 8d3ad759) and 5 defective cases were handled correctly. Recommended patches enforce a mandatory per-case failure-mode checklist and variant-invariant extraction to close the recall gaps.
